Demonstratives are sensitive for gender, not for number. Nevertheless, the change from singular to plural nouns also comes up with the change in demonstratives. It does not happen because of the number feature of the nouns carrying, but the language is mostly sensitive to change singular nouns having masculine feature to plural nouns that have feminine feature. That is why demonstratives vary in singular and plural modified nouns as exemplified below.
